integrity: The proof is self-contained and finite exact-algebra checks are auxiliary. Independent mathematical review and publication-priority assessment have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: A sufficient trace-class coefficient condition is imposed; zero spectral structure, singular values, global eigenvector basis, and perturbation conditioning are not claimed. Historical factorable-matrix Jordan theorems may provide broader coverage.
title: Exact nonzero Jordan structure and resonance for multivariable Rhaly operators
